exports.name: CollapseDirective
exports.summary:
Toggles a `dui-collapsed` class on a target element when the host is clicked.
Used internally by {@link CollapsibleComponent}'s chevron icon, but can be applied standalone.
exports.summaryZh: 点击宿主元素时，切换目标元素上的 `dui-collapsed` 类。内部用于 {@link CollapsibleComponent} 的箭头图标，也可独立使用。

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: The element whose collapsed/expanded CSS class is toggled.
inputs.descriptionZh: 被切换收起/展开 CSS 类的目标元素。

inputs.name: collapsed
inputs.description: Current collapsed state; setting it applies/removes the CSS classes immediately.
inputs.descriptionZh: 当前收起状态；设置该值会立即应用/移除对应的 CSS 类。

outputs.name: toggle
outputs.description: Emits the new collapsed state whenever it changes.
outputs.descriptionZh: 收起状态发生变化时发出新的状态值。

exports.name: CollapsibleComponent
exports.summary: A titled panel with a built-in chevron toggle that expands/collapses its projected content.
exports.summaryZh: 带标题的面板，内置箭头开关，用于展开/收起投影进来的内容。

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Panel title text (translated via the `translate` pipe).
inputs.descriptionZh: 面板标题文字（通过 `translate` 管道翻译）。

inputs.name: collapsed
inputs.description: Initial collapsed state; toggling the chevron icon updates this internally.
inputs.descriptionZh: 初始的收起状态；点击箭头图标会在内部更新该状态。
